Verified working end to end, no errors. Open **http://maker:4001** and let's confirm the combined flow with three quick actions.

**1 — A routine save (the quick path).** Paste this and press **Save**:
```
https://recipes.example.com/ramen
```
The pre-filled preview appears. If it looks right, just press **Save** again to confirm — notice a good save is essentially paste → Save → Save.

**2 — A save where you fix something first.** Paste this and press **Save**:
```
https://developer.mozilla.org/css-grid
```
This time, in the preview, shorten the title before confirming — see how correcting *before* it's saved feels.

**3 — Editing something already saved.** On the **NASA** item (already in your list), press its **Edit** button. Notice it opens the *same* screen you used while saving. Shorten the title to *"James Webb Space Telescope"* and press **Save**.

One thing I decided that I'd like you to check: on that screen, **Cancel** backs out without saving — for a brand-new link that means it won't be added at all, and for an existing bookmark it leaves it unchanged. Please confirm that's the behaviour you'd expect from Cancel.

**After trying all three, tell me: does this match what you had in mind — and did the earlier auto-fill and details still work the way you liked?**
